name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
description: Open standard (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) enabling AI applications to securely connect to data sources and tools. 'A USB-C port for AI applications.' Devin uses MCP to mount tool servers into agent sessions — both Anthropic-shipped and customer-built.

name: STDIO transport
description: Local MCP transport. Server runs as a local process; stdin/stdout exchange JSON-RPC messages. Required fields: command, args, env vars. Best for local CLI-based servers (npx, uvx, docker). Stdout MUST contain only valid JSON-RPC — any logging/debug output to stdout breaks the protocol.

name: SSE transport (Server-Sent Events)
description: Remote MCP transport over Server-Sent Events. Required fields: server URL, headers. Legacy / being deprecated in favor of Streamable HTTP. Devin still supports it for legacy server compatibility.

name: Streamable HTTP transport
description: Remote MCP transport over Streamable HTTP. Required fields: server URL, headers. Recommended for new integrations — more reliable across clients (Cloudflare, OpenAI, Claude). Endpoint convention: `<server-base>/mcp`.

name: MCP `tools/list` method
description: Standard MCP RPC method that returns the server's available tools. Devin's 'Test listing tools' button invokes this against a freshly-spun-up isolated environment. Servers that connect but expose no tools have typically not implemented this method or have failed to register tools (often due to missing env vars).

name: MCP Marketplace
description: Curated catalog of vetted MCP servers, browsable in Settings > MCP Marketplace. Many MCPs are 1-click enable; others require credentials (API keys, OAuth tokens, headers). 'Add Your Own' surface for custom servers.

name: Add Your Own (custom MCP server)
description: MCP-Marketplace surface for adding any custom MCP server. Form-driven: server name, optional icon, short description, transport type (STDIO/SSE/HTTP), transport-specific config. JSON schema is shown for clarity but not edited directly.

name: Test listing tools (button)
description: MCP-Marketplace UI action that spins up an isolated environment, connects to the configured server, and attempts tool discovery via tools/list. Disabled until the server config is saved. Validation failures categorize as: connectivity, authentication, or timeout.

name: Devin MCP server
description: Cognition-hosted MCP server providing programmatic access to Devin's platform — sessions, playbooks, knowledge, schedules, integrations — plus repository documentation/search. Base URL https://mcp.devin.ai/. Authenticated; requires a Devin API key. Supports public + private repository access (unlike the free DeepWiki MCP).

name: DeepWiki MCP server
description: Free, no-auth Cognition-hosted MCP server providing access to PUBLIC repository documentation/search via DeepWiki. Base URL https://mcp.deepwiki.com/. Three tools: read_wiki_structure, read_wiki_contents, ask_question. The light-weight public counterpart of Devin MCP.

name: Tool: read_wiki_structure
description: Get a list of documentation topics for a GitHub repository. Available on both DeepWiki MCP (public repos) and Devin MCP (public + private with auth).

name: Tool: read_wiki_contents
description: View full documentation for a GitHub repository. Available on DeepWiki MCP (public) and Devin MCP (public + private).

name: Tool: ask_question
description: Ask any question about one or more repositories (up to 10 on Devin MCP) and get an AI-powered, context-grounded response. Available on DeepWiki MCP (public) and Devin MCP (public + private).

name: Tool: list_available_repos
description: List all repositories available to query with the authenticated Devin account. Devin MCP only.

name: Tool: devin_session_create
description: Create one or more Devin sessions. Each session can have a prompt, title, playbook, tags, and ACU limit. Devin MCP only.

name: Tool: devin_session_search
description: Search and filter Devin sessions by tags, playbook, origin, schedule, user, creation/update time. Devin MCP only.

name: Tool: devin_session_interact
description: Interact with a Devin session. Sub-actions: get status, send messages, sleep, terminate, archive, read messages and attachments, manage tags. Devin MCP only.

name: Tool: devin_session_events
description: Inspect events within a session — list summaries, fetch full event details, search event contents by text. Devin MCP only.

name: Tool: devin_session_gather
description: Wait for multiple Devin sessions to reach a settled state (finished, errored, sleeping, or waiting) before returning. Useful after creating parallel sessions instead of polling in a loop. Devin MCP only.

name: Tool: devin_playbook_manage
description: Full CRUD for playbooks. List, get, create, update, delete. Supports automation macros (e.g., `!my_macro`). Devin MCP only.

name: Tool: devin_knowledge_manage
description: Full CRUD for knowledge notes — list, get, create, update, delete, browse folder structure. Also manages knowledge SUGGESTIONS — list, view, dismiss pending. Filters: repo, folder, search query. Devin MCP only.

name: Tool: devin_schedule_manage
description: Full CRUD for schedules. Supports cron expressions (recurring), one-time scheduling, notification preferences, agent selection. Devin MCP only.

name: Tool: list_integrations
description: List native integrations (GitHub, Jira, Slack) and MCP servers with install status + settings URLs. Filter: installed | not-installed | all. Devin MCP only.

name: X-Org-Id header (enterprise auth)
description: HTTP header that enterprise service-user keys and PATs MUST send to specify which Devin organization to target. The MCP tools operate on org-level resources (sessions/playbooks/knowledge); the org_id is otherwise auto-resolved from org-scoped service-user keys.

name: Devin API key (`cog_` prefix)
description: Auth token for Devin MCP server. Three flavors: org-scoped service user key (auto-resolves org), enterprise service user key (requires X-Org-Id), personal access token (requires X-Org-Id). All three use `cog_` prefix. Legacy `apk_`/`apk_user_` prefixes are NOT supported.

name: Database Toolbox (CognitionAI)
description: Apache-2.0 production-ready Docker images that connect AI agents to 22+ database systems through MCP. Built on Google's Database Toolbox base. Universal interface across SQL/NoSQL/graph/analytics platforms. Universal image: `us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/database-toolbox/toolbox/toolbox:latest`.

name: Database Toolbox `--prebuilt` mode
description: Database Toolbox CLI flag `--prebuilt <db-id>` for databases with built-in support. 12 prebuilt: AlloyDB, BigQuery, Cloud SQL (MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQL Server), Dataplex, Firestore, Looker, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Spanner, SQL Server. Most common configuration mode.

name: Database Toolbox `--tools-file` mode
description: Database Toolbox CLI flag `--tools-file <path.yaml>` for databases requiring custom configuration YAML files. ~10 databases use this mode: Bigtable, Couchbase, Dgraph, MongoDB, Neo4j, Redis, Redshift, Snowflake, SQLite, TiDB, Valkey.

name: Metabase MCP server (CognitionAI)
description: MIT-licensed Cognition-built MCP server for Metabase analytics platform. 81+ tools spanning Dashboard Management (23), Card/Question Management (21), Database Management (13), Table Management (16), additional tools (9). Tool-loading flags: --essential (default), --all, --write, --read. Auth: API key (preferred) or username/password (fallback).

name: Metabase MCP tool-loading flags
description: Metabase MCP server CLI flags controlling which subset of tools to load: --essential (default — minimal set), --all (load all 80+ tools), --write (write/modification tools only), --read (read-only tools only).

name: Read-only connection (production DB pattern)
description: Recommended pattern for connecting Devin to production databases via MCP: use a read-only connection string OR a database user with restricted permissions. Devin executes queries based on user instructions; scoping access prevents accidental writes.

name: MCP server OAuth flow
description: First-time auth path for OAuth-based MCP servers. Devin prompts the user (during their first session OR when they click 'Test listing tools') to visit a URL and complete OAuth in a browser. Devin waits for the callback. ONLY org admins can authenticate OAuth-based MCP servers.

name: OAuth service-account recommendation
description: Strong recommendation: use a SERVICE ACCOUNT (not a personal account) when authenticating OAuth-based MCP servers. Access is shared across the organization; all members' sessions use the same authenticated connection.

name: Cataloged marketplace MCPs (one-click)
description: Many marketplace MCPs require no configuration — just click 'Enable'. The user is prompted to connect a service account during their first session or via 'Test listing tools'. Includes: AlloyDB, Asana, Atlassian, BigQuery, Cloud SQL (MySQL/PostgreSQL/SQL Server), Cloudflare, Cortex, Dataplex, Fireflies, Firestore, Jam, Linear, Looker, Metabase, MySQL, Neon, Notion, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Sentry, Spanner, SQL Server, Vercel.

name: Linear native MCP tools (auto-mounted)
description: When the Linear integration is connected, Devin already has native Linear tools using the integration's authentication. Linear MCP does NOT need to be configured separately from the marketplace.

name: Snyk MCP pattern (custom env + CLI install)
description: Snyk MCP requires three steps: (1) configure the MCP server with custom env var (not in default docs), (2) install Snyk CLI on Devin's machine, (3) trust folder. Some scans require an `unmanaged: true` flag (e.g., C++) which can be set in knowledge or during a session.

name: Devin as data analyst (in Slack via DB MCPs)
description: Use case: connect Devin to database MCPs (Postgres, BigQuery, etc.) and trigger from Slack with !ask. Devin acts as a data analyst answering ad-hoc questions over the data. Step-by-step guide on the marketplace docs page.

name: Session logs debugging (MCP failures)
description: When an MCP server fails during a session, Devin logs the error in session output. Look for MCP-related messages — connection errors, tool-call timeouts, schema mismatches. The first stop for debugging custom MCP server issues.

name: Universal Database Toolbox Docker image
description: Single Docker image at `us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/database-toolbox/toolbox/toolbox:latest` that powers all 22+ Database Toolbox configurations. SBOM, provenance attestation, multi-arch support. Pulled once; runs configured per database via flags + env vars.

name: Metabase MCP — 81+ tools coverage
description: Metabase MCP server's tool surface: 23 dashboard-management, 21 card/question-management, 13 database-management, 16 table-management, 9 additional (collections/search/users/activity/playground-links). Effectively complete Metabase API coverage.

name: Metabase MCP — API key auth (preferred)
description: Preferred Metabase MCP authentication via METABASE_API_KEY env var. Server logs 'Using Metabase API Key' when active. Alternative fallback: username/password (METABASE_USERNAME + METABASE_PASSWORD).

name: Legacy API key prefix not supported
description: Devin MCP server does NOT accept legacy `apk_` / `apk_user_` prefix API keys. Customers using legacy keys must rotate to a service-user API key (`cog_` prefix) before connecting MCP clients.

name: DeepWiki MCP — no-auth, public-only
description: DeepWiki MCP server is a free, no-authentication-required service. Public repositories ONLY. For private-repo access, use the authenticated Devin MCP server (mcp.devin.ai) instead.
